_note: Section A (set up once). Fill this in with the team; the pipeline reads it for every video.

fonts._note: Path to a .ttf on the server. For Hindi use a Devanagari font, e.g. NotoSansDevanagari-Bold.ttf
fonts.heading: brand/fonts/heading.ttf

visual_style: bright, aspirational modern Indian lifestyle, warm natural light, rich black and gold accents, photorealistic, cinematic, shallow depth of field

tone_guide.voice: warm, friendly, reassuring and confident; short punchy Hinglish lines; like a helpful friend, never pushy
tone_guide.compliance: Lending ad: no interest rate, loan amount, tenure or approval time unless given exactly in the brief. Do not promise approval. Encourage responsible borrowing. The T&C disclaimer is added to the end card automatically - do not repeat it. No alcohol, smoking or gambling in visuals.

strategy.audience_default: salaried and self-employed Indians, 22-40, metro and tier-2 cities

disclaimer: T&C apply. Loans subject to eligibility.
visual_avoid: alcohol or drinks glasses, smoking, gambling, cash being thrown, real bank logos, scary debt imagery
